evals.prompt: Write me a prompt I can paste into ChatGPT to turn raw meeting notes into a list of action items. Each item needs an owner and a due date if one was mentioned; output as a Markdown table. The notes will be pasted in after the prompt.
evals.expected_output: One copyable prompt that asks for a Markdown table of action items, owners, and due dates, says what to do when an owner or date is missing, and uses no all-caps emphasis or Claude-only features.
expectations: [deterministic] A1: The reply contains exactly one fenced code block, and it holds the prompt
[deterministic] A3: The prompt specifies the output as a Markdown table with columns for the action item, the owner, and the due date
[deterministic] A4: The prompt contains none of the words CRITICAL, MUST, NEVER, ALWAYS, or IMPORTANT written in all capitals
[judgment] A3: The prompt says what to do when an item has no owner or no due date
[judgment] A6: Nothing in the prompt depends on a Claude-only feature such as a prefilled response, an extended-thinking setting, or naming Claude

evals.prompt:
This is the system prompt I use with Claude Opus 5.5 for code review. The reviews come back bloated and slow. Improve it.

You are an EXPERT senior engineer. CRITICAL: You MUST review EVERY line. NEVER miss a bug. ALWAYS double-check your work before answering. Don't be vague. Don't use bullet points. Review the code below.
evals.expected_output: A revised prompt with the all-caps emphasis and the double-check instruction removed and the prohibitions turned into positive instructions, followed by a short list of changes tied to the bloated, slow reviews.
expectations: [deterministic] A1: The reply contains exactly one fenced code block, and it holds the revised prompt
[deterministic] A4: The revised prompt contains none of CRITICAL, MUST, NEVER, ALWAYS, or EXPERT written in all capitals
[deterministic] A5: The revised prompt contains no instruction to double-check, re-check, or re-verify the work
[deterministic] A8: After the code block, the reply lists what changed, with a reason for each change
[judgment] A4: The revised prompt turns at least one of the "Don't ..." instructions into a positive statement of what to do instead
[judgment] A8: The explanation ties at least one change to the reported symptom of bloated or slow reviews
